dedupe_keys.name: kausal paths city emissions scenario model

description: Kausal Paths is a city emissions scenario application published by Kausal Tech. It projects emissions from historical city inventories and planned climate actions and lets users compare alternative paths. The repository documents a Python application with a GraphQL API, PostgreSQL storage and a shared-code submodule; an optional private extensions submodule is separate from the public core. Inputs are city emissions histories, action definitions and scenario parameters. Outputs are projected emissions by selected city, sector and future period. Geographic coverage depends on configured city data. Public core source is AGPL-3.0, but a local installation needs database and application setup. A limitation is that the optional private extensions and local inventories may not be available, so a public checkout alone does not reproduce a city's deployed result. The tool can compare urban building, transport and energy decarbonisation assumptions. The catalogue's data-ipcc-ar6-scenarios-database has global scenario pathways, not this city application. No private extension, city dataset or server was accessed.
